 2m ago 12.23 EST Fulham 1-1 Newcastle United
 Premier League match report: Rodrigo Muniz came off the bench to rescue a point for Fulham and deny Matthias Jaissle a welcome victory after a difficult week. Jacob Steinberg reports from Craven Cottage …
 Muniz rescues late point for Fulham against Newcastle after Murphy stunner Read more Share 3m ago 12.21 EST Arsenal 1-0 Hull City
 Premier League match report: It took a while but the reigning champions got there in the end, as Martin Odegaard’s fifth goal of the season was enough to ensure that Arsenal took all three points against an obdurate Hull side. Ed Aarons reports from the Emirates Stadium …
 Martin Ødegaard extends Arsenal lead at top with winner to break Hull resistance Read more Share 8m ago 12.17 EST Nottingham Forest v Manchester CIty - live!
 Premier League: Tom Bassam has the latest from the City Ground, where Nottingham Forest are taking on a Manchester City side that have lost their past two Premier League matches.

 Share 14m ago 12.11 EST FA Cup: Seventh tier side Guiseley have pulled of one of the results of the round so far, knocking out National League side Sutton United with a late penalty. Barnsley spanked seven goals past Aldershot in a 7-2 demolition job at Oakwell, while Bradford City scored seven without reply against Marine.
 The dream has died for phoenix club AFC Rushden Diamonds from the eighth tier, after they lost 4-0 away at Burton, while Worcester City lost 1-0 away at Colchester. Salford City lost 1-0 away at Carlisle, while Harrogate were smashed 4-0 at home by AFC Fylde. Blackpool have been taken to extra time by non-League Hornchurch, while last year’s giant-killers Macclesfield have lost 3-0 away at Mansfield Town.
 Harborough Town have gone out to Leyton Orient, Plymouth saw off ALvechurch 4-0. In arguably the most non-League tie of the day, Salisbury Town ran out 6-0 winners over Sholing, while York City beat their fellow League Two side Northampton, scoring four unanswered goals.

 Premier League: Rodrigo Muniz cancelled out Jacob Murphy’s worldie to enure the points were shared at Craven Cottage.
 Share 27m ago 11.57 EST Arsenal 1-0 Hull City
 Premier League: Arsenal made heavy weather of it but have taken the three points courtesy of a goal from their skipper, Martin Odegaard. They go six points clear of Manchester City, who kick off against Nottingham Forest in about 30 minutes time.
 Share 29m ago 11.55 EST Championship: It looks like heartbreak for Burnley at the Cardiff City Stadium, where the hosts have come from 4-1 down to lead 5-4 courtesy of Alex Robertson who scores with a thunderbolt from 30 yards out.
 Share 32m ago 11.52 EST Championship: Jay Stansfield scores his second goal of the game at St Andrews, where Birmingham City now lead 10-man Swansea City 2-1 in the knockings of their match.
 Share 34m ago 11.51 EST Championship: West Ham have pulled a goal back against Blackburn at Eqood Park, where Joel Piroe scored for Scottie Parker’s Hammers in the 82nd minute.
 Share 35m ago 11.49 EST Championship: West Brom go 3-0 up against Millwall, with Felix Horn Myhre getting his name on the scoresheet.
 Share 36m ago 11.48 EST FA Cup: Truro’s National League South game at Folkestone Invicta was called off after the visitors’ midfielder Yassine En-Neyah had a medical emergency and was taken to hospital. Here’s hoping it’s nothing too serious.
 Truro City game at Folkestone called off after Yassine En-Neyah has medical emergency in warm-up Read more Share 39m ago 11.45 EST Championship: Wowzers! Cardiff City have equalised against Burnley to make it 4-4 in a ding-dong battle at at the Cardiff City Stadium. Yousef Salech gets his second goal of the game to make it all square. At Loftus Road, QPR have gone 2-1 up against Lincoln City through Glen Kamara. At the Valley, Matty Godden has put Charlton Athletic 2-1 up against Sheffield United.

 Share 54m ago 11.30 EST Championship: It’s Blackburn 2-0 West Ham at Ewood Park, where Oladapo Afolayan has fired a low shot home from just outside the penalty area. Meanwhile at St Andrews, 10-man Swansea Cirty have equalised against Birmingham City through a Christopher Klarer own goal at a corner.
 Share 1h ago 11.27 EST Championship: The goals keep flying in at the Cardiff City Stadium, where Yousef Salech has pulled a goal back for the hosts, who trail Burnley 4-2.
 Share 1h ago 11.26 EST Premier League: It’s looking like slim pickings for tonight’s Match of the Day, with both today’s three o’clock kick-offs still scoreless. Declan Rice has just been subbed off by Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta. The midfielder and Kai Havertz have been replaced by Viktor Gyokeres and Mikel Merino.

Photograph: Julian Finney/Getty Images Share Updated at  11.28 EST 1h ago 11.24 EST Championship: Cardiff City midfielder Alex Robertson hacks an attempted clearance into his own goal to increase his side’s arrears. It’s Cardiff City 1-4 Burnley in the Welsh capital.
 Share 1h ago 11.18 EST Championship: Largie Ramazani restores Burnley’s two-goal lead at the Cardiff City Stadium, where they lead 3-1. The Belgian scores with a left-footed shot into the top corner and Burnley look set to win just their second match of the season.
 Share 1h ago 11.12 EST FA Cup: Will Evans scores for Plymouth Argyle to give them a one goal lead against Alvechurch from the seventh tier.
 Championship: Andri Gudjohnsen scores with a diving header at the far post to put Blackburn one up against West Ham at Ewood Park. It’s his 11th goal of the season in all competitions.
 View image in fullscreen Plymouth’s Will Evans beats the Alvechurch ‘keeper. Photograph: Dave Rowntree/PPAUK/Shutterstock Share Updated at  11.32 EST 1h ago 11.10 EST Championship: Millwall’s defenders back off as Isaac Price picks up the ball inside his own half, advances and fires into the bottom corner to give West Brom a 1-0 lead at the Hawthorns.
 Share 1h ago 11.08 EST Championship: With his team trailing 2-1 at home to Burnley, Cardiff City midfielder Jack Moylan hits the post early in the first half.
 Share 1h ago 10.56 EST An email: “I have to commend referee Farai Hallam on his excellent bait and switch on the Emirates crowd,” writes Kari Tulinius. “When he first told them that Mendy had committed a holding offence, only to follow that up by clarifying that Havertz was offside, the Gooners reacted en masse like children being told there would be dessert, and that it would be broccoli. I burst out laughing … and I’m an Arsenal fan.”

 Share 2h ago 10.43 EST Championship: In news of goals I haven’t got around to giving you yet, Preston lead Southampton at Deepdale thanks to Jordan Thompson’s strike, while Dom Jeffries has cancelled out Richard Kone’s opener to restore parity for Lincoln City at Loftus Road.

Photograph: Gavin Ellis/TGS Photo/Shutterstock Share Updated at  10.40 EST 2h ago 10.33 EST Championship: A couple of minutes after Swansea City midfielder Marko Stamenic was sent off in his side’s match against Birmingham City for an ill-advised lunge, Jay Stansfield fires the hosts in front at St Andrews.
 Share 2h ago 10.31 EST Championship: Marcus Edwards doubles Burnley’s lead against Cardiff City in the Welsh capital. After two draws under new boss Fabio Celestini, the Clarets look set fair to get their first win.

 Khadija Shaw’s hat-trick moves Manchester City clear of Chelsea at WSL summit Read more Share 2h ago 10.24 EST Premier League: Harvey Barnes gets on the end of a good Jacob Murphy cross to bring a decent save out of Fulham goalkeeper Bernd Leno at Craven Cottage.
 Share 2h ago 10.23 EST Premier League: In the match between Fulham and Newcastle at Craven Cottage, Lucas Hornicek puts the ball out for a corner in saving a curled effort from Oscar Bobb. Gonzalo Garcia fails to convert with a free-header at the far post from the subsequent inswinger.
 Share 2h ago 10.21 EST Premier League: Elliot Stroud brings an excellent save out of Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya after capitalising on a mistake from Riccardo Calafiori, who coughed up cheap possession to Hull City.
